me5.structure: English ME-era pack: 10 cards + basic energy/code card = 4 Common, 3 Uncommon, 1 reverse holo (Poke Ball/Master Ball patterns), 1 reverse/hit slot that can be upgraded to Illustration Rare / Special Illustration Rare / Mega Hyper Rare, and 1 rare slot (Rare, or upgraded to Double Rare / Ultra Rare).
me5.notes: TCGplayer Authentication Center, 4,000+ English packs (reported 2026-07-21): DR 21.02%, UR 8.30%, IR 11.01%, SIR 1.25%, MHR 0.09% (~1/1081, +/-0.09%, least certain). Rates are community/retailer samples, not official (TPC publishes none).

Black White Rare has no reliable rate (0 in 700+ packs; ~2 in 1,000; others estimate 1/1,789) - used 1/1000 (approximate). Poké Ball/Master Ball patterns ignored. Slot 4 is a plain Uncommon.
